data.gender_notes: Ilka is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ilka is derived from the Finnish word 'ilkea', which means 'happy' or 'joyful'. In Finnish folklore, Ilka was the name of a spirit or deity associated with happiness and joy. The name Ilka carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ilka usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
